_about: v2.4 plan 08 T18 per-role calibration, authoring role (runAuthoringStage: the wizard's real stage prompt, parser, validator and its one repair pass). Labels frozen 2026-09-25 BEFORE any model answer was read. validity = the product's own verdict is 'ok' or 'questions'. opShape = status 'ok', every op is a kind the stage prompt allows ('Only emit ... ops', read from the rendered prompt), and at least `require.min` ops of `require.kind` whose `require.match` fields hold; a 'questions' answer passes opShape only when `ask` is 'allowed' (a premise too thin to proceed on). Floors are in 08-author-observability.md section 'Per-role calibration floors' and in `floors` below; they are never retuned. Do not edit a label after a run; add a case instead.

cases.message: Add a bool quality for whether the alarm has been tripped.
Add an int quality counting how many guards the crew has knocked out.
Add an enum quality for where the crew is: street, lobby or vault.
Set up the qualities.
Add an intermediate checkpoint between the start and the vault where the crew cracks the lobby door.
Add a final anchor checkpoint called Getaway, where the crew escapes the city with the gold.
Add an intermediate checkpoint between the ruins and the inner chamber: the party solves the sun door puzzle.
Wire the start to the vault: the crew moves on once they have the key.
Connect the camp to the ruins when the party agrees to go, and the ruins to the inner chamber once the torch is lit.
Give the vault checkpoint an author's note telling the narrator that the alarm bells are ringing.
Add Vex to the roster: the crew's lockpick, nervous but brilliant.
Create what this story still needs on this install.
Añade una cualidad booleana para saber si el grupo ha encontrado la reliquia.
Añade una cualidad entera que cuente cuántas antorchas quedan encendidas.
Añade un punto de control intermedio, La escalera, entre la entrada y la cripta.
Añade un ancla final, La salida, donde el grupo escapa de la abadía con la reliquia.
Conecta la entrada con la cripta cuando la puerta esté abierta.
Conecta la niebla con la cubierta cuando la tripulación haya abordado el barco, y la cubierta con el camarote cuando hayan leído el diario del capitán.
Añade una nota del autor en la cripta: el aire huele a humedad y a muerte.
Añade al reparto a Mara, la guía del grupo, que conoce la abadía.
